questions.q_en: Which of the following is smaller than 1/5?
questions.solution_en:
1/5 = 0.2

2/7 = 0.28, 1/4 = 0.25, 1/6 = 0.166, 1/3= 0.333

So, 1/6 < 1/5

Also, if a fraction has numerator = 1 and denominator > 5, it will be smaller than 1/5.

questions.q_en: If a seven-digit number 7H7774T is divisible by 8 and 13, then what is the value of H and T?
questions.solution_en:
A seven-digit number 7H7774T is divisible by 8 and 13.

By divisibility rule of 8, last three digits of the number must be divisible by 8.

So, value of T = 4

By putting H = 7, the given number should be divisible by 13.

Hence, value of H = 7 and T = 4

Suresh is 1(2/7) time faster than Naresh. In a race, Suresh gives a head start of 50 m to Naresh. Find the length of the race if both finished the race at same time.
questions.solution_en:
Ratio of speed of Suresh and Naresh = 1(2/7) : 1 = 9:7

Let speed of Suresh and Naresh is 9X m/s and 7X m/s respectively.

Let distance covered by Naresh = L m

Since, both reach at the same time -

(L + 50)/9X = L/7X

7L + 350 = 9L

2L = 350

L = 175

The length of race = 175 + 50 = 225 m

In ∆ABC, two medians AD and BE intersect at G at right angles. If AD = 12 cm and BE = 9 cm, then the length of AB is equal to:
questions.solution_en:
We know that a centroid divides median in the ratio 2:1,

As they intersect at G, so AG:GD=2:1

So , AG=(2/3)AD and also GD=(1/3)AD

So AG=(2/3)*12=8 cm

And GD=(1/3)*12=4 cm

Similarly for BE:-

BG=(2/3)*BE and GE=(1/3)*BE

So BG=(2/3)*9=6 cm

GE=(1/3)*9=3cm

So now on applying pythagoras we have:- (as medians intersect at right angles)

AB2 = AG2 +BG2

AB2=82 + 62 =100

So AB=10 cm

Option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: If the total surface area of the cylinder is 1012 cm2 and the height of the cylinder is 16 cm, then find the volume of the cylinder.
questions.solution_en:
The total surface area of the cylinder = 2πr (h + r)

1012 = 2 * 22/7 * r (16 + r)

161 = 16r + r2

r2 + 16r - 161 = 0

r2 + 23r - 7r - 161 = 0

r (r + 23) - 7 (r + 23) = 0

(r - 7) (r + 23) = 0

r = 7 [Neglect negative value]

The volume of the cylinder = πr2h

= 22/7 * 7 * 7 * 16

= 2464 cm3

questions.q_en: The 8th  term of an arithmetic progression is -17 and 17th  term is -71, find the 13th  term?
questions.solution_en:
"

N th  of an AP = a + (n – 1)d where a is first term and d is common difference

–17 = a + (8 – 1)d

–71 = a + (17 – 1)d

From above equations we get a = 25 and d = –6

13 th  term = 25 + (13 – 1)( - 6) = –47

"

A boat running downstream covers 493 km in 17 hours while covering the same distance upstream takes 12 hours more than that of downstream. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
questions.solution_en:
Speed of boat downstream = distance / time = 493 / 17 = 29 km/hr

Speed of boat upstream = distance/ time = 493/ (17 + 12) = 17 km/hr

Speed of boat downstream = speed of boat in still water + speed of current = 29 km/hr

Speed of boat upstream = speed of a boat in still water - speed of current = 17 km/hr

Speed of boat in still water = (29 + 17) /2 = 23 km/hr

questions.q_en: If the base of a right pyramid is a triangle of sides 8 cm, 24 cm, and 25 cm and its volume is 928 cm3, then find its height.
questions.solution_en:
The given base is a triangle with sides 8 cm, 24 cm, and 25 cm. Since

82 + 242 = 252, it is a right triangle with:

Base = 8 cm, Height = 24 cm, Hypotenuse = 25 cm

The area of a right triangle = 1/2 X Base X Height

= 1/2 * 8 * 24

= 96 cm2

The volume of the pyramid = 1/3 * area of base * height

928 = 1/3 X 96 X h

h = 29 cm

questions.q_en: A number when divided successively by 14, 11 and 19, leaves remainders of 5, 9 and 17 respectively, with quotient becoming the dividend for each successive step. When the second smallest such natural number is divided by 25, then what is the remainder?
questions.solution_en:
Let k be the integer quotient after the 3 successive divisions

Then the number at the end of 2nd successive division must have been of the form (19k + 17)

Then the number at the end of 1st division must have been of the form {11(19k + 17) + 9}

Then the original number can be represented as 14{11(19k + 17) + 9} + 5.

= 14{209k + 187 + 9} + 5

= 14{209k + 196} + 5

= 2926k + 2744 + 5

= 2926k + 2749

Hence second smallest such natural number is 5675, when k = 1. When divided by 25, the remainder shall be 0.

Express Method

Let the last quotient be 1.

The dividend for 19 = 19 x 1 + 17 = 36

The dividend for 11 = 11 x 36 + 9 = 405

The dividend for 14 = 14 x 405 + 5 = 5675

So, the number is 5675.

When 5675 is divided by 25, we get 0 as a remainder.

questions.q_en: Diameter of a circle is equal to the diagonal of a square and sum of area of circle and that of square is 252 cm2, then what is the length of side of square? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution_en:
Let radius of circle be 'r' cm.

Let side of square be 'a' cm.

Now,

2r = a√2

r = a/√2 ....... (1)

Area of circle + Area of square = 252

πr2 + a2 = 252

From equation (1):

π * (a/√2)2 + a2 = 252

a2 [π/2 + 1] = 252

a2 [(11/7) + 1] = 252

a2 (18/7) = 252

a2 = 98

a = 7√2

Length of side of square = 7√2 cm
